EARLIEST_CREATED.LABEL: Earliest created
EARLIEST_CREATED.DESCRIPTION: The conversation that was created first gets assigned first.

LONGEST_WAITING.LABEL: Longest waiting
LONGEST_WAITING.DESCRIPTION: The conversation waiting the longest gets assigned first.

FAIR_DISTRIBUTION.LABEL: Fair distribution policy
FAIR_DISTRIBUTION.DESCRIPTION: Set the maximum number of conversations that can be assigned per agent within a time window to avoid overloading any one agent. This required field defaults to 100 conversations per hour.

EXCLUSION_RULES.LABEL: Conversation filters
EXCLUSION_RULES.DESCRIPTION: Conversations with selected tags or older than the duration will not enter auto-assignment.

LOAD_CONTROLS.LABEL: Limits and ownership
LOAD_CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Simple assignment rules: assignment delay, open conversation cap, monthly new-client quota, and sticky owner routing.

DELAY.LABEL: Assign after, min
DELAY.DESCRIPTION: New conversations enter the queue only after this delay.

MAX_OPEN.LABEL: Max open
MAX_OPEN.DESCRIPTION: Exclude an agent when they already own this many active conversations. Pending conversations are counted when the pending handoff toggle is on.

ASSIGN_PENDING.LABEL: Assign after AI agent
ASSIGN_PENDING.DESCRIPTION: Apply this policy to pending conversations waiting after AI or bot handling. Delay and workload limits still apply.

ONLINE_ONLY.LABEL: Assign only online agents
ONLINE_ONLY.DESCRIPTION: When enabled, only online inbox members receive new conversations. Turn it off to include busy and offline members.

STICKY_OWNER.LABEL: Prefer previous owner
STICKY_OWNER.DESCRIPTION: Return a known client to the same agent when that agent is available.

INBOXES.DESCRIPTION: Add inboxes for which this policy will be applicable.
